verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's documented surfaces are its own web UI/PWA and an API. The evidence pack shows no first-party bridge that lets a user chat with the assistant from inside WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or iMessage. Webhook notifications to Discord/Slack, inbound webhook posts into Open WebUI channels, API keys, and Python Functions are adjacent notifications or developer building blocks, not a native messenger chat surface.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can talk to my assistant from the messengers I already use — WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or iMessage — not just a bespoke web page
